title: World's first open ledger for in-field agricultural data based on open source SatEO

ms.promise:
This first milestone of the project will consist of: 
・Successfully developed a technical framework for interpreting input data for any given agricultural field (in Kenya) into a universal standard and format linked to the unique field ID and the associated block-chain ledger, this will include development of APIs and integration end points. 
・Successfully developed the front-end interface for inputting data for stakeholders, i.e. this will also rely on the automatically delineated field boundaries from Idea #26780, the web-application will be able to collect and convert data in our DB to match #1.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria in this milestone will be successful development of the solution for both 1 and 2 and prototyped this to the broader Cardano community to leverage and build additional services and tools on top of, providing the fundamental baseline and blue print, i.e. a measurable KPI for this milestone would be: customised and accessible web-application which has the ability to process input from Geojson files which contains field-level information, which is then added to AWS database and table associated with individual field boundary.
ms.report:
Milestone 1 Proof of Achievement Documentation and Report:
During the first milestone we successfully completed the tasks and milestones according to the plan, i.e. the first milestone tasks commenced on 11th of March (2024) and was successfully completed on 11th of June (2024) and included the following tasks:
・Develop the technical framework for interpreting input data for any given agricultural field (in Kenya) into a universal standard and format linked to the unique field ID and the associated block-chain ledger, this will include development of APIs and integration end points. 
・Report and conclusion: this has been successfully completed, we processed 34 Sentinel-2 tiles (i.e. 340,000 sq.km, approx. 3.4 million hectares) of initial crop land area in Kenya based on 2024 growing season, and super-resolved Sentinel-2 data (from European Space Agency, highest publicly and freely available SatEO data in the world) from 10 meter per pixel to 1 meter per pixel resolution (across 12 spectral bands), this is critical in order to be able to delineate field boundaries accurately in the region, considering the size of parcels are typically smaller than 1 or 0.5 hectares, and the default spatial resolution of Sentinel-2 at 10 meter is not sufficient. This screenshot shows all the AOIs and S2-tiles which have been processed as well as this report includes all the S2-tiles and areas included in this first milestone. Additional info on this delivery includes: processed and identified the Sentinel-2 tiles in Kenya with the highest density of crop land, e.g. the crop ha corresponds to sq.km of crop-area per each Sentinel-2 tile (10k sq.km area).
